claims: Federal income taxes for the 2025 tax year are due on April 15, 2026.
The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to filing returns.
The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to paying any taxes owed.
The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to submitting extension requests.
An automatic six-month extension pushes the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
October 15, 2026 is the extended deadline to file tax returns.
An extension grants more time to file paperwork.
An extension does not grant more time to pay taxes owed.
The deadline for Q1 quarterly estimated tax payments is April 15, 2026.
The deadline for Q2 quarterly estimated tax payments is June 15, 2026.
The deadline for Q3 quarterly estimated tax payments is September 15, 2026.
The deadline for Q4 quarterly estimated tax payments is January 15, 2027.
